basic_info.description:
Discover this stunning Jr. 1 Bedroom condo at the coveted Beacon complex, offering the perfect blend of luxury and convenience. Featuring laminate floors, full tile bathroom, granite countertops, in-unit washer and dryer, and newer appliances, this home is move-in ready. The private patio provides a peaceful outdoor escape, ideal for both you and your furry friend, with easy access to a dog park on the same floor. Comes with a leased parking spot.

The Beacon boasts top-tier amenities, including a 24/7 lobby attendant, pool, fitness center, spa, clubhouse, and more. Located steps away from the Caltrain station, Oracle Park, and the bustling dining scene with hotspots like Saison and Kaiyo Rooftop, you're perfectly positioned for both work and play. Enjoy the best of city living with Safeway right in the complex and unbeatable proximity to the Financial District, Ferry Building, Embarcadero, and Chase Center.

Dont miss this rare opportunity for luxury, privacy, and community in the heart of Mission Bay!
